short: Bookish Do Not Sell My Books
twin: the source print (womens-bookish-do-not-sell-my-books-hoodie, 3346 x 3433) is a MAROON-ink engraving for light blanks (Sand/Ash only) with DO NOT SELL MY BOOKS above and AT MY FUNERAL. below (the live print wins over the brief's shorter transcription; both lines kept word for word), clean row gaps either side of the stack-and-candle art (rows 261-3132 kept). Both lines were cropped away and re-set beside the art, since the art is tall and narrow. Ash keeps the original maroon art; for Black/Navy the maroon ink was recolored to rose (darker ink = brighter rose) and the neutral dark fills to charcoal, so no dark ink is printed on a dark blank.
